# Lemonade + MCP: Local AI Agent

> Reference architecture for AI agents driven by [MCP](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/) tool servers (headless browser, filesystem, URL fetch, port scanner).
Backend-agnostic: works with any OpenAI-compatible endpoint — [Lemonade Server](https://github.com/lemonade-sdk/lemonade) (the original target, AMD-optimized
local inference), [LM Studio](https://lmstudio.ai/), [vLLM](https://docs.vllm.ai/), [Ollama](https://ollama.com/),
[llama.cpp](https://github.com/ggerganov/llama.cpp), or hosted providers like [OpenAI](https://platform.openai.com/), [Groq](https://groq.com/),
[Together AI](https://together.ai/), [Mistral](https://mistral.ai/), [DeepSeek](https://deepseek.com/) — plus native adapters for
[Google Gemini](https://ai.google.dev/) and [Anthropic Claude](https://docs.anthropic.com/). The provider is auto-detected from the endpoint URL.
Ships two interchangeable agent implementations — a single-binary Go agent and a Python alternative — sharing one declarative `agent.json` config.

The Go agent is production-leaning: per-query safety limits with strict-only client overrides, OpenTelemetry traces and metrics (OTLP push and Prometheus pull),
a REST + MCP gateway, human-in-the-loop tool approvals, secret redaction in logs, and a live web dashboard with SSE event streaming. Local-only
configurations need no API keys; cloud backends accept the relevant `LLM_API_KEY` / `OPENAI_API_KEY` / `GEMINI_API_KEY` / `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` env vars.

## Documentation

- [README](README.md): top-level overview, prerequisites, and the default quick-start path (clone → validate → build → start an LLM backend → run agent).
The default walkthrough uses Lemonade Server; pointing the agent at any other supported backend is a single `-endpoint` flag.
- [Go agent README](go-agent/README.md): architecture, REST API, MCP SSE gateway, per-query safety limits, observability, configuration, model
zcompatibility, extending with custom MCP servers
- [Python agent README](docs/README.md): Hugging Face Tiny Agents setup and usage

## Configuration

- [Go agent config](go-agent/agent.json): default MCP servers (Playwright + filesystem + fetch + ports) and model
- [Go agent system prompt](go-agent/PROMPT.md): default agent prompt — customize for your use case
- [Python agent config — Linux/macOS](docs/agent.json)
- [Python agent config — Windows](docs/agent-windows.json)
- [Python agent system prompt](docs/PROMPT.md)

## Source code (Go)

- [main.go](go-agent/main.go): CLI entry, flag parsing, signal handling, OpenTelemetry wiring
- [agent.go](go-agent/agent.go): agent lifecycle, session table, startup checks
- [session.go](go-agent/session.go): per-session state and the agent loop (LLM ↔ tool cycle, history trim, parallel tool dispatch)
- [llm.go](go-agent/llm.go): OpenAI-compatible LLM client with streaming, TTFT metrics, retries, and `parseServerError`
- [gemini.go](go-agent/gemini.go) / [anthropic.go](go-agent/anthropic.go): native adapters for Gemini and Anthropic APIs
- [mcp.go](go-agent/mcp.go): MCP server lifecycle, tool filtering (`allowTools`), tool bridging
- [limits.go](go-agent/limits.go): per-query safety limits and clamping logic
- [config.go](go-agent/config.go): config loading, env expansion, tool-call style detection, provider auto-detection
- [policy.go](go-agent/policy.go): termination heuristics (terminal errors, repeated tool failures)
- [web.go](go-agent/web.go): web dashboard scaffolding (handlers split into `web_query.go`, `web_admin.go`, `web_mcp.go`)
- [events.go](go-agent/events.go): SSE event types and broadcaster
- [metrics.go](go-agent/metrics.go): OpenTelemetry metrics — six instruments, OTLP push + Prometheus pull at `/api/v1/metrics`
- [otel.go](go-agent/otel.go): OpenTelemetry tracing setup
- [approval.go](go-agent/approval.go): human-in-the-loop tool approval queue
- [queue.go](go-agent/queue.go): job queue for async REST requests
- [ratelimit.go](go-agent/ratelimit.go): per-IP token-bucket rate limiter
- [redact.go](go-agent/redact.go): secret redaction in log output
- [static/index.html](go-agent/static/index.html): embedded dashboard UI (no build step)

## Example narrow MCP server

- [mcp-servers/ports/main.go](mcp-servers/ports/main.go): reference port-scanner MCP server (stdio + SSE transports, zero external dependencies) — a worked example of building your own narrow MCP server
